input.quote: Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: Preferred position met: 12-month automatic renewals, a 30-day Customer opt-out (extended if the 60-day Vendor reminder is not sent), and renewal uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%.

input.quote: This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: New York law with exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts of New York County, and no arbitration — exactly our preferred position.

input.quote: Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Preferred position met: free Customer assignment to Affiliates and successors, Vendor assignment (including by change of control) requires our consent and never to a competitor, and Section 24.4 bars any Vendor termination, repricing or suspension on our change of control.
